about: General reminders shown with results. Each quote is copied word for word from the named source; never reword, shorten or merge them. Shown only when the list has at least one Chinese herb and one Western medicine.

reminders.quote_en: In general, Chinese medicines should be administered at least 1-2 hours before or after the western medicines. However, this can only avoid the potential drug-drug interactions occurred due to direct contact in the stomach, and cannot avoid any potential interactions occurred after the drugs are absorbed into the body.
reminders.quote_zh: 一般而言，服用中藥和西藥要相隔至少一至兩小時。不過，這只能避免藥物在胃部因直接接觸所產生的相互作用，而無法避免藥物在吸收進入人體後所產生的任何潛在相互作用。

source.title_en: Learn more about interactions between Chinese medicines and western medicines
source.title_zh: 中西藥相互作用知多少
